news.headline: The cooling trap: how Asia’s air conditioners are making heatwaves worse
news.summary: As heatwaves become more frequent and intense across Asia, the region faces a dangerous power paradox. Soaring demand for air conditioning threatens to push electricity grids closer to failure just as extreme heat puts the infrastructure under greater strain, raising the risk of cooling disappearing

news.headline: Reporter’s note: two Delhis, one weekend – when the world came to dinner
news.summary:
I grew up in Delhi. Not Lutyens’ Delhi, that quieter, greener stretch of tree-lined avenues and high-walled colonial bungalows where the VIPs live. But close enough to know that two cities share one name.
One Delhi is generally messy. Rubbish piled into small mountains by the roadside. No footpaths
